title: Compact metric sets admit convergent subsequences
statement: Let $(X,d)$ be a metric space, let $C\subseteq X$ be compact with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology], and let $x:\mathbf N\to X$ have $x_n\in C$ for all $n$. There exist $a\in C$ and a strictly increasing $\phi:\mathbf N\to\mathbf N$ such that $d(x_{\phi(k)},a)\to0$ as $k\to\infty$.
